# `_msuf*` frame fields that are read without any writer in the shipped tree
# and are *correct that way*. Read by .github/scripts/msuf_static_checks.py
# (check_frame_fields). One exact field name per line; `#` starts a comment.
#
# Only two things belong here:
#   * a field whose writer is outside the shipped Lua (an older addon version
#     that persisted it into SavedVariables, Blizzard, or another addon), and
#   * a dynamic write the gate cannot see. The gate already resolves
#     `frame[key] = v` in a file that spells the field as a string literal and
#     any `"_msufPrefix" .. name` key family, so a dynamic write normally needs
#     no entry here; add one only with a comment naming the write site.
#
# A read with no writer that is *not* one of those two is a defect (a typo, or
# a writer that was removed). It does not belong here - fix it, or carry it in
# msuf_frame_fields_baseline.txt until it is fixed.

# Migration marker for Aura 2 v11f lane offsets. MSUF 2.x wrote it into
# SavedVariables (old MSUF_Defaults.lua / MSUF_Presets.lua); 6.x only reads it
# to decide whether the retired buff/debuffOffset aliases are still live.
# Read: State/MSUF_Defaults.lua.
_msufA2_migrated_v11f
